unmapped_blocks.text: Job title: *
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including ability to effectively communicate with internal
Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing
6 - 9 years of working experience as a Software Engineer
Mandatory certification (if Any):
Good to have skills:
Project /Customer Name or Strategic Requirement *
Work Base Location: *
Experience range: (Min to Max years) *
Start Date of the Position/Requirement *
No. of Positions: *
Education and Work Experience Requirements:
This section is used to describe what knowledge, skills and abilities are required to perform the daily tasks
and external customers both in English.
exemplary customer service
Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions
given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices
Mandatory Skills:
Several years of programming experience in
Java17+ Spring / Spring Boot, AWS (Experience in developing and using AWS services, especially in
the area of IaC )SQL, Angular 15+, Node.js.
Clean code principles- Pair programming, code reviews
High quality code aspiration- Load / performance testing, Experience in DevSecOps
4+ years of experience in the applications:
Kafka, Elastic Search, Splunk, Docker, Git/Gitlab, SonarQube, JIRA/Confluence
Agile product development according to Scrum/SAFe
Agile MindsetTeam Player- Willingness to take on responsibility.
Responsibilities:
Development and operations of the existing system landscape as well as ensuring maintainability, reliability, and
scalability.
Active participation in Scrum and SAFe team events.
First experience in migrating a system landscape to the Cloud are a great benefit for the candidate.
AWS certifications
